name: Footnotes in Callouts and Tables
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Numbers footnote IDs without inherited object properties.
Replaces complete labels with punctuation or supplementary Unicode letters.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Footnotes whose labels have punctuation or rare Unicode letters now show as numbered links.
Footnote markers inside code blocks stay plain text, also when the block uses tildes or a longer fence.
tip: Turn off 'Show numbers' to show named labels instead of numbers for named footnotes.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Footnotes in Callouts and Tables is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your tables.
